__author__ = 'MoonBall'
import sys
M = 1000000007

def main():
    P, K = map(int, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split())
    k = [K * x % P for x in range(P)]

    if not K:
        sys.stdout.write(str(pow(P, P - 1, M)) + '\n')
        return
    if K == 1:
        sys.stdout.write(str(pow(P, P, M)) + '\n')
        return

    visited = bytearray(P)
    cycle_counts = [0] * P
    ans = 1

    for start in range(P):
        if visited[start]:
            continue
        node = start
        clen = 0
        while not visited[node]:
            visited[node] = 1
            node = k[node]
            clen += 1
        cycle_counts[clen] += 1

    for i in range(2, P):
        c = cycle_counts[i]
        if c:
            ans = ans * pow(i * c + 1, c, M) % M

    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
